report_name: Carlisle Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP) 2022 - 2037
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used as a data source to identify the most popular cycle routes for school and travel-to-work journeys within the district.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation framework that assesses effectiveness (potential to generate cycling trips), alignment with policy objectives, economic factors (scheme cost, value for money, likelihood of attracting funding), and deliverability (engineering constraints, land ownership, and stakeholder support).
specific_evidence_of_impact: The plan has secured £19.7m from the Towns Fund for sustainable travel and public realm, £20m from the Borderlands Inclusive Growth Deal for the Carlisle Station Gateway, £50m for the Carlisle Citadels University Campus, and £9.1m from the Future High Streets Fund for city centre improvements.
pct_usage_quote: The most popular cycle routes [17] for both school and travel to work journeys within the district are all located within the urban area of Carlisle.
